what: Shep, a real farm dog painted as a real animal: a big, lean, long-legged young male sheepdog, a black-and-white cross between a collie and a shepherd dog, deep-chested and narrow-waisted, built for running all day across fields. His coat is LONG-HAIRED like a working sheepdog's: long straight glossy hair that lies flat and smooth along his body, never shaggy, never fluffy, never short; even the white hair on his chest lies flat and smooth; the long hair hangs in a straight fringe under his chest and belly, feathers down the backs of his legs, and hangs from his long tail in a long straight fringe. His head is a shepherd dog's: long and wedge-shaped, a flat sloping forehead, a long narrow tapering muzzle and a long nose, a lean narrow jaw. Two tall, stiff, triangular ears stand straight up off the top of his head and come to sharp points. He is black and white: glossy jet-black over his back, his flanks, the top of his head and his ears; bright clean white on his chest ruff, his throat, his muzzle, a narrow white blaze up the middle of his face, the long feathering on his legs and the tip of his tail. There is no tan or brown anywhere in his coat: only glossy black and clean pure white. His eyes are warm dark brown, keen and bright.
colours: glossy jet-black coat on the back, flanks, top of the head and ears; bright clean white on the chest, throat, muzzle, a narrow facial blaze, all four legs and the tail tip; warm dark brown eyes; a black nose; a pink tongue.
wears: He is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: He is a dog on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, a little from the front so all four feet can be seen: he is streaking forward at a flat-out gallop, his lean body stretched out long and low, his two front legs reaching far forward together and his two hind legs driving out behind, exactly four legs and no more, his tall pointed ears standing straight up, his mouth a little open, his long tail streaming out straight behind him, his sleek coat pressed flat by the wind.
must_show: a big lean black-and-white farm dog, plainly a real dog
two tall stiff pointed ears standing straight up
a long-haired coat lying flat and sleek, with straight fringes under the belly, on the legs and tail
a long wedge-shaped shepherd head with a long narrow muzzle
a flat-out streaking gallop, painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: German shepherd tan and black saddle colouring
